description: Supabase Edge Functions with no caller check, in both scaffolded forms (`serve()` from the Deno std http server and `Deno.serve()`). This is the dominant server surface on Vite-based AI-builder apps, which have no Next.js route handlers at all — docs/research/class-a-detection.md measured it as the single largest 'no authentication at all' shape the rule set could not see.
